baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence أرسلنا ... وجعلنا في ذريتهما النبوة والكتاب anchors sending, deliberate placement, descent, prophecy, and book in one construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Message-bearing envoys are released, while prophecy and a joined textual deposit are deliberately installed within a lineage pictured as minute and dispersive. The descendants are therefore a transmission medium, not a claim that every descendant holds the prophetic office.

activation_trace.role: The messenger and carried-message image supplies the outbound commission that begins the transmission channel.
Making something occupy a state or rank makes the placement of prophecy and book deliberate rather than genealogically automatic.
Minute particles spreading provide the material image for a lineage that multiplies and disperses its deposit.
The envoy who reports from God specifies prophecy as a commissioned office within the broader line.
Joining one thing to another pictures the book as a composed and durable deposit carried by the line.

changed_reading.before: Noah and Abraham were sent, and prophets and scripture later occurred among their descendants.
changed_reading.after: God establishes a message-bearing channel and places a durable prophetic-textual deposit in a biologically dispersing lineage without equating lineage membership with prophetic office.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فمنهم مهتد ... وكثير منهم فاسقون divides people from inside the same منهم group into an attuned individual and numerous exiters.
baseline_models.mechanism: Guidance is accepted direction toward a path, whereas fisq is imaged as a moist date leaving its skin. The verse therefore contrasts active uptake with departure from a containing norm; shared descent carries access but does not determine response.

activation_trace.role: Gentle indication toward path and truth makes the muhtadi an active receiver of direction, not merely a member of the line.
Numerical growth makes the many a conspicuous outcome of propagation rather than a marginal exception.
A moist date emerging from its skin supplies a precise boundary-exit image for loss of alignment with the inherited deposit.

changed_reading.before: Some descendants were rightly guided, but many were sinful.
changed_reading.after: One lineage contains opposed relations to its deposit: some receive direction, while many emerge out of the norm that had contained them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated object والكتاب is governed by جعلنا and stands beside النبوة.
baseline_models.mechanism: The book can be heard simultaneously as gathered composition and as an inscription that fixes judgment or obligation. Placed beside prophecy, it preserves and binds a commission beyond the life of an individual messenger.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate assignment to a state gives the book an installed function within the descendants.
Joining and stitching supplies the book's gathered, transmissible form.
Inscription that imposes judgment or measure supplies the book's binding force.

changed_reading.before: The descendants received scripture alongside prophecy.
changed_reading.after: A composed and norm-fixing instrument is installed beside the prophetic office so the commission can endure, be applied, and also be departed from.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, the same making construction places people in successor status, while the ultimate inheritance remains God's. This recasts the focus lineage as temporary stewardship of a transmitted deposit rather than hereditary ownership of it.

activation_trace.role: Making people occupy a successor condition supplies the deliberate assignment that parallels جعلنا in the focus.
Coming after another and standing in its place turns descent into delegated succession.
Transfer from predecessor to heir supplies inheritance language while the ayah reserves the final estate to God.

structural_cues: 57:7 couples جعل with the participle مستخلفين, before the focus reuses جعل for prophecy and book.
57:10 states that the inheritance of the heavens and earth belongs to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assigned succession and God's ultimate inheritance; I infer that the lineage holds prophecy and book in trust. Biological succession without this stewardship nuance remains a live alternative.

changed_reading.before: Prophecy and book are possessions of a distinguished family line.
changed_reading.after: The line is appointed to carry a deposit across successors, but neither descent nor custody converts that deposit into hereditary property.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier matching coda supplies a process between receiving a book and becoming many fasiqun: extended time reaches a long horizon, hearts lose softness, and members leave the book's containing norm. The focus ending becomes a diagnosis of transmission erosion over generations.

activation_trace.role: The written-book image supplies the inherited deposit from which the temporal process begins.
Long duration supplies generational extension rather than a single act of refusal.
A thing's far terminus sharpens the accumulated horizon across which the deposit can lose force.
Loss of the heart's softness supplies the internal change that precedes the repeated coda.
Numerical increase exactly repeats the focus ayah's scale marker.
The shell-exit image exactly repeats the focus outcome and links it to the preceding time-and-heart sequence.

structural_cues: 57:16 and 57:26 end with the exact sequence وكثير منهم فاسقون.
In 57:16 the sequence book, prolonged term, hardened hearts, then the repeated coda is explicit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered time, hardening, and repeated-coda sequence; I infer an erosion arrow from duration through hardening to exit. Hardening and fisq could instead be coordinated outcomes rather than a strict causal chain.

changed_reading.before: Many descendants simply happen to be disobedient.
changed_reading.after: The many can be read as the long-horizon failure mode of a transmitted book: custody persists while responsive hearts harden and members move outside its norm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding ayah couples sent messengers and the book with balance so that people rise to equity. Prophecy and book in the focus are thus not merely family heirlooms or private teaching; they are a public apparatus intended to generate upright collective practice.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and carried-message imagery repeats the focus's opening commission immediately before it.
A written determination that fixes judgment gives the book normative public force.
The balance of justice supplies the criterion by which the transmitted book is enacted.
Rising with resolve toward an affair supplies the people's active implementation rather than passive possession.
Justice and equity state the social result against which custody of prophecy and book is tested.

structural_cues: 57:25 immediately precedes the focus and repeats لقد أرسلنا before naming الكتاب.
The purpose clause ليقوم الناس بالقسط makes public enactment the stated endpoint of the preceding delivery sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies messenger, book, balance, rising, and equity in a purpose construction; I carry that function into the adjacent focus deposit. Public justice may be one contextual function of the book rather than its exhaustive meaning.

changed_reading.before: The book is a sacred text preserved within a prophetic family.
changed_reading.after: The deposited book is an executable public measure whose successful transmission is visible when people stand up for equity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah overlays biological descent with a second continuity: messengers are made to follow surviving traces, a son is named by lineage, and adherents follow him. The focus ذرية becomes the physical scaffold of transmission, while trace-following and allegiance describe its operative continuity.

activation_trace.role: Following a trace in succession supplies a commissioned chain that proceeds after earlier messengers.
A remaining mark that discloses what came before supplies the durable track along which the chain advances.
Message-bearing envoys are the successive agents moving along that trace.
Sonship and attribution to an origin retain the biological axis rather than replacing it.
Allegiance and continued following supply a non-biological axis of continuity among adherents.

structural_cues: 57:27 begins with ثم and twice uses قفينا directly after the focus lineage statement.
The ayah places ابن and الذين اتبعوه in the same continuation, preserving descent while adding adherence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trace-following, messengers, sonship, and adherents; I infer two intersecting transmission axes, descent and enacted following. They may simply coexist rather than formally redefine ذرية.

changed_reading.before: Prophecy and book continue chiefly through biological descendants.
changed_reading.after: Biological descent carries the channel, but its live continuity proceeds by following prophetic traces and joining the succession through allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The continuation distinguishes an invented discipline from what was written as an obligation, grants that it sought divine approval, then faults failure to preserve it before repeating the fisq coda. This sharpens fisq as exit through failed observance of a norm one received or undertook, not a flat label for innovation or ancestry.

activation_trace.role: Beginning a practice without a prior model supplies the community-made institutional form.
Inscription that imposes judgment distinguishes divinely fixed obligation from the invented form.
Seeking a desired object preserves the stated orientation toward approval and prevents innovation alone from carrying the blame.
Preserving and tending a covenant supplies the maintenance function that the community failed to perform.
The repeated shell-exit image makes the failure of maintenance a departure from an inhabited normative form.

structural_cues: 57:27 orders ابتدعواها, ما كتبناها, ابتغاء رضوان الله, فما رعوها, and then وكثير منهم فاسقون.
The exact focus coda recurs after a contrast between sincere aim and failed observance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies invention, non-prescription, sincere seeking, failed tending, and the repeated coda; I infer that failed maintenance activates the focus's shell-exit image. The final many may denote a wider population than the practitioners alone.

changed_reading.before: Fasiqun are simply morally bad members of the descendants.
changed_reading.after: The many fasiqun are legible as custodians who no longer preserve the normative form they inherited or undertook, even where the undertaking began with a sincere aim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next appeal describes God making light for people to walk by. This operationalizes the focus muhtadi: guidance is not a static pedigree or label but an enabling illumination expressed in continued movement.

activation_trace.role: Making something occupy a condition parallels the focus placement but now assigns usable light to responders.
Illumination supplies the perceptible guidance by which direction can be maintained.
Walking and movement turn guidance into a practiced trajectory rather than inherited status.

structural_cues: 57:28 immediately addresses believers after the two lineage ayat and conditions the gift on renewed response.
The instrumental phrase تمشون به makes the light useful through movement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies made light and walking by it; I infer that this concretizes the focus root h-d-y as enacted orientation. The light may be a consequence of guidance rather than a definition of it.

changed_reading.before: The muhtadi is the descendant who possesses correct belief.
changed_reading.after: The muhtadi is the responder whose received direction becomes enough light to keep moving along a path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing ayah names a community by affiliation with the book yet denies that this affiliation gives it power over divine favor; ownership remains in God's hand. Read backward, placing the book in descendants establishes custody and responsibility, not control over access or gift.

activation_trace.role: A group defined by closeness and belonging supplies communal affiliation around the book.
Enrollment in a register or group sharpens how relation to a book can become a corporate identity.
Effective capacity to act or possess is explicitly denied as a consequence of that affiliation.
Favor as beneficent gift defines what cannot be monopolized by the lineage or book-community.
The owning hand locates control of favor with God rather than with its historical custodians.

structural_cues: 57:29 closes the unit by naming أهل الكتاب immediately after the lineage, book, and response sequence.
The negated capacity clause is followed by the positive statement that favor is in God's hand.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies book-affiliation, denied capacity, gift, and God's owning hand; I infer a backward restriction on proprietary readings of 57:26. The immediate addressees may be narrower than every descendant in the focus.

changed_reading.before: A lineage containing prophecy and book enjoys privileged control over divine favor.
changed_reading.after: Lineage and book identify a custodial history, but favor remains a gift outside that community's ownership or power of allocation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it links an earlier eschatological boundary scene to the focus's concrete date-skin branch rather than asserting a direct lexical equivalence. It remains anchored in فاسقون, its supplied shell-exit image, and the focus pronoun منهم, which locates the exiters inside the lineage before departure. Downstream prose should call it a spatial resonance or exploratory architecture, not claim that fisq etymologically means crossing the wall or that every detail of 57:13 explains 57:26.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فاسقون is supplied only with the image of a moist date leaving its skin, and منهم marks those so described as emerging from within the same descendant group.

activation_trace.role: The moist date leaving its skin supplies the focus's literal inside-to-outside boundary crossing.
Showing one door while concealing another exit supplies a deceptive route through a containing structure.
A high surrounding wall supplies an explicit social and spatial boundary.
The entrance supplies a regulated passage rather than an undifferentiated division.
The inside of a thing supplies the protected interior pole of the contrast.
The back or exterior opposed to the belly supplies the exposed outside pole.

changed_reading.before: The many fasiqun are merely people assigned a negative moral category.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are insiders who have crossed out of a containing prophetic-textual form, echoing the surah's architecture of hidden exits, wall, door, interior, and exterior.

strongest_changes: The lineage is a stewarded transmission channel, not hereditary ownership of prophecy, book, or divine favor.
The exact 57:16 coda turns the many fasiqun into a long-term erosion pattern involving inherited book, prolonged time, and hardened hearts.
57:25 makes public equity the enacted test of the deposited book, while 57:27 adds trace-following and observance to biological continuity.
57:28 renders guidance operationally as made light by which a responder keeps walking.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's compact genealogy became a mechanism of custody, uptake, and loss because the same coda appears earlier after temporal hardening and immediately afterward after failed tending. The unusually concrete f-s-q shell-exit branch also preserved a contained spatial reading that a generic moral paraphrase would erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The arrows from prolonged time to hardening and from failed observance to fisq are strongly sequenced but still reader-supplied causal inferences.
Trace-following and adherence may supplement biological lineage without redefining ذرية itself.
The boundary-architecture outlier should remain an exploratory resonance rather than a lexical claim.
